checks.name: Light/dark and comfortable/compact reflow, text/control contrast, density change, and 44px primary targets
Keyboard skip link focuses main; native disclosure opens and closes by keyboard
Search and status filters expose empty results and recover through reset
Connection toggle retains a stable accessible name; disconnection/reconnection preserve confirmed execution and pending command
Keyboard run navigation restores the invoking control; requested cancellation stays Running until acknowledgement
Returning from a filtered-out selected run preserves filters and detail context, then reset preserves selection
Live reduced-motion and explicit motion-off make feedback immediate
Actual local fallback font families and Vietnamese sample recorded
System follows live appearance changes; explicit appearance/density/motion persist; blocked, invalid, and malformed storage retain usable defaults
No-JavaScript run details and native disclosures remain readable; runtime controls stay disabled; text contrast passes
No browser runtime errors, external resource requests, or failed preview resources

limits: No screen-reader, touch-device, native browser zoom, or real backend testing.

Contrast samples are rendered HTML text composited over solid backgrounds and enabled select/text-input boundaries against their fill and adjacent background. SVG artwork, disabled controls, placeholders, text selection, native popup menus, and backgrounds with images are outside this check.
Fallback font families are recorded from Chromium. Named webfont files are not distributed or loaded.
The temporary verification server exposes only the preview directory. Links to neighboring Atlas documents are checked separately, not followed here.
